# Beacon CRM rollout

**As of:** 13 October 2026  
**Overall status:** ⚠️ Amber  
⚠️ Schedule · ❔ Budget · ⚠️ Scope · ✅ Risk

## Executive summary

Beacon CRM rollout is on track for company-wide go-live on 16 November despite training guide delays and a pending scope decision. Training guides slipped 14 days to 30 October (1 other milestone also slipped), and 1 change request awaits approval (CR-14 email plugin integration). The notes don't cover budget. Decisions needed: Decision on CR-14 email plugin integration; Send executive all-hands announcement of go-live date by 2 November so people block time for training.

## Status by dimension

| Dimension | Status | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Schedule | ⚠️ Amber | Largest slip: non-critical milestone 'Training guides', 14 days (2 milestones slipped in total). |
| Budget | ❔ Unknown | No planned budget figure in the notes. |
| Scope | ⚠️ Amber | 1 change request pending approval. |
| Risk | ✅ Green | 2 open items, none high-impact. |

## Accomplishments this period

- Pilot completed with 41 users and NPS of +32
- Data migration test load completed

## Next steps

- Rerun data migration with new match rules on Thursday
- IT to work on SSO config for contractor accounts
- Cutover runbook draft by 23 October
- Dress rehearsal on 7 November
- Steering committee to review CR-14 next Thursday

## Top risks and issues

- **Test load of legacy records showed approximately 2% failed deduplication. Rerunning with new match rules on Thursday.** (medium impact)  
  Owner: Priya Raman · Mitigation: not stated
- **SSO configuration for contractor accounts still open. IT has a ticket.** (low impact)  
  Owner: Priya Raman · Mitigation: not stated

## Decisions and asks for leadership

- Decision on CR-14 email plugin integration
- Send executive all-hands announcement of go-live date by 2 November so people block time for training

## Gaps in the notes

- No budget figures provided
- No cost or schedule estimate for: CR-14 email plugin integration
